parsed.note_claim: The Sagrada Família is not fully complete; while the central Tower of Jesus Christ was finished in 2026, the Glory Façade and other elements remain unfinished.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Sagrada Família may now appear complete, but it is far from done. With the Tower of Jesus Christ now built ... attention has turned to the Glory Facade.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states the basilica is far from done despite the tower completion and identifies the Glory Facade as remaining work.
